name: Make Record (UNTP Digital Traceability Event)
description: UN Transparency Protocol 0.7.0 Digital Traceability Event holding one MakeEvent: a supplier product was used to make the issuer's product.
summary: Credential type template for the UNTP 0.7.0 DigitalTraceabilityEvent, a W3C VCDM 2.0 credential (jwt_vc_vcdm) with the UNTP context and schema, used as a Make record in workflows/dpp-workflow.md. Its credentialSubject is an array of one MakeEvent (type MakeEvent and LifecycleEvent) with the event date and time, activity type, facility, input (supplier) and output products, and links to both passports. It is issued with no holder and published as a "dte" link (untpLinkType). Issued by the noop/dpp_manufacturer wallet template.
